bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be clear plastic and no larger than 12x12x6 inches. Non-compliant bags are not allowed.
allowed: clear plastic bags no larger than 12x12x6 inches
prohibited: Containers with a capacity larger than 1 liter
Umbrellas larger than 16 inches or with a point
Bags that are not clear plastic and are larger than 12x12x6 inches
Signs on poles or sticks or constructed of wood or metal material
Any other items deemed to be dangerous or inappropriate
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions may be made for medical reasons.

parking.note: Parking in Edmonton includes on-street and off-street options with hourly rates ranging from $1 to $4.50. Event parking rates apply during major events at Rogers Place. The first 15 minutes of on-street parking are free, but registration is required.

rideshare.note: The curb lane on 112 Avenue eastbound from 95 Street to Stadium Road is a dedicated drop-off and pick-up location for the public and rideshare. A taxi stand is located outside the stadium, on 89 Street and 112 Avenue.

concessions.note: Commonwealth Stadium offers a variety of food and beverage options including premium offerings at market areas on the east and west sides. Highlights include the Teriyaki Chicken Burger, Gourmet Bacon Burger, and Ukrainian Dog. The Legends Club and Jackie Parker Room provide exclusive experiences for Elks Season Seat Holders and ticket holders respectively.
stands: Chicken and Rib East and West
Salty Snacks SE, NE and West

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Commonwealth Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Commonwealth Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Commonwealth Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Commonwealth Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
